sample:
This pay item shall consist of mobilization and demobilization for the construction of the project. The
project shall be constructed in phases as shown in the plans. This pay item shall be inclusive of any
and all mobilizations and demobilizations associated with the project. Mobilization shall be defined as
all necessary equipment, supplies, materials, and personnel on the job site ready to begin
construction.

Site Clearing and Grubbing (Includes all
Tree, brush, and root system removal)

Construct in accordance with NCTCOG specification 204.1 . Measurement and payment shall be as
listed in bid proposal.

Provide a Storm Water Pollution Prevention Plan (SWPPP) for storm water discharge in accordance
with TPDES general permit TXR150000 and or EPA regulations. This shall include the assumption of
responsibility of said pollution prevention system, including the design and implementation of said
system, complete in place. Moreover, when it comes to (SWPPP), the contractor has the sole
authority, responsibility and control over plans and specification of the said (SWPPP) only and can
make changes to those specifications for the entire project as he deems necessary or needed to
remain in compliance with the TCEQ and or EPA regulations. Construct all items included in (SWPPP)
in accordance with NCTCOG specification 202. Measurement and payment shall be as listed in the bid
proposal and include all items deemed necessary for compliance with said (SWPPP).

Furnish lime material for subgrade stabilization in accordance with NCTCOG specification 301.2 (Lime
Treatment) Measurement and payment shall be as listed in the bid proposal.

Furnish and install 12-inch HDPE storm drain pipe in accordance with NCTCOG specification 501.22
(Thermoplastic Corrugated / Smooth-Lined Storm Water Pipe and Fittings), with trench excavation,
embedment, and backfill per NCTCOG 504 and 505 (Open Cut).Measurement and payment shall be as
listed in the bid proposal.

Furnish and install 3-ft by 3-ft drop inlet grate in accordance with NCTCOG specification 502.12
(Structures) and applicable Standard Drawings (Division 6000, Storm Water Drainage). Measurement
and payment shall be as listed in the bid proposal.
